items.title: Scorecard Holder
items.excerpt:
For the golfer who wants to disconnect, leave the GHIN App or 18 Birdies in the bag and do it how it used to be done. Fits most standard scorecards and easily fits into a back pocket. Clasp securely holds stacks of dollar bills - if you are into that sort of thing.

  • Black Full Grain Leather

  • Complimentary Navy thread

  • Made here in Denver

items.title: Tee Ring
items.excerpt:
178 yard Par 3, down wind and you got the 7 iron in your hard. Your playing partners are waiting for you to throw a dart, and you have no tee. The worst. Keep them close by, throw a handful on this handy little key ring so you aren’t left hunting for that ‘perfect’ broken tee up at the box.

  • Black Full Grain Leather

  • Complimentary Navy thread

  • Fits up to 4 Tees

  • Made here in Denver

items.title: The Quilted Pouch
items.excerpt:
Significant other ever get a tiny bit upset when you’re gone for eight hours on a Saturday golfing with the fellas? Likely. We kind of solved it with this Valuables Pouch though because these special pouches are made by my wife at Queen City Quilt Co.. If you’re going to be gone, make sure you are carrying little bit of them with you!

  • Drawstring closure to keep valuables inside

  • Two Tone - Black/Navy

  • Fits up 39 tees, 17 ball markers, five repair tools and three balls

  • Made here in Denver

items.title: Hammered Copper Repair Tool
items.excerpt:
In collaboration with my good buddy Chuck, we wanted to craft the perfect Repair Tool that will only get better with age. Handmade and hammered with the gentlest hands, these tools aren’t going anywhere - now let’s hope they help you on the green.

  • ‘MS’ stamp on the front

  • ‘DS’ stamp on the back

  • Made in Georgia

items.title: The Bag Tag
items.excerpt:
Toss it on your travel bag, throw it on your Sunday Bag or add it to your favorite duffel. It’s all about the little things that add flare and get the conversations going. Add your address to the inside and rest a little easier.

  • Black Full Grain Leather

  • Complimentary Navy thread

  • Made here in Denver

items.title: Staple Sunglass Case
items.excerpt:
The little things matter, all the way down to making sure the specs are protected. Throw it in that weird extra pocket in your bag for when the sun starts hiding and feel good. Like everything else from Magpie Supply, watch this case patina and look better over time.

  • Crafted using ‘Rough Out’ leather

  • Complimentary Navy thread

  • Made here in Denver

items.title: The Magpie x RossCo Headcover
items.excerpt:
Crafted in Bandon, Oregon by Rossco Golf. Nice clubs deserve nicer sleeping bags and these are just that. Those first tee jitters are still going to be there, but no chance Carl doesn’t recognize how cool your Driver Headcover is.

  • Magpie on the crown

  • Aqua Blue Crown

  • Pendleton Grey Shaft

  • Fits Drivers and 3 Woods
